offlineReady: Modeli etegekeddwa, ekola nga tewali yintaneeti
notSureMessage: Tetusobodde kukizuula bulungi. Ddamu okukuba ekifaananyi mu kitangaala ekirungi oba weebuuze ku mukugu w'ebyobulimi.
decisionSupport: Amagezi gano gayamba mu kusalawo naye tegadda mu kifo kya mukugu mu byobulimi.
installOffline: Giteeke ku ssimu okugitandika mangu nga tewali yintaneeti.
footerLine: Amagezi ag'ebyobulimi agasigala ku kyuma kyo.
landingIntro: Kebera ekikoola ky'omuwogo, manya eby'okulaba era ofune ekiddako eky'okukola. Ebifaananyi byo bisigala ku ssimu yo.
landingPhotoAlt: Abalimi b'omuwogo mu Uganda nga bakungula awamu
landingWorksOffline: Ekola nga tewali yintaneeti ng'emaze okutegekebwa
landingSectionTitle: Obuyambi obwangu mu nnimiro yo ey'omuwogo
landingSectionIntro: Ekitabo eky'omukwano mu ssimu yo, gy'obeera wonna.
offlineIntro: Modeli bw'emala okutegekebwa, kebera ebikoola nga tewali yintaneeti.
landingDisclaimer: PlantPulse ewa obuyambi mu kusalawo, naye eddagala lya nnimiro terisikira mukugu mu by'obulimi.
settingsIntro: Londa engeri app gy'erabika n'olulimi lw'eyogera ku kyuma kino.
clearScansHint: Gyawo ebyafaayo by'ebikebereddwa ku kyuma kino
aboutDeveloperHint: Modeli, ekyuma n'engeri y'okukola nga tewali yintaneeti
clearConfirm: Osazeewo okugyawo ebikebereddwa byonna ku kyuma kino? Kino tekisobola kudda mabega.
takePhotoIntro: Londa ekikoola kimu eky'omuwogo mu kitangaala ekirungi. Ekifaananyi kisigala ku kyuma kino.
photoAdvice: Laga ekikoola kimu mu musana. Weewale ebifaananyi ebitali byeyolefu oba ebiddugavu ennyo.
cameraPreview: Ekifaananyi kya kamera mu kiseera kino
cameraUnavailable: Kamera teriwo wano. Kozesa ekifo okulonderamu ekifaananyi.
cameraDenied: Tokkirizza kamera. Osobola okulonda ekifaananyi ku kyuma kyo.
steadyPhone: Kwata essimu nga tenyegenyega era weewale ebisiikirize.
analyzingIntro: Kino kiyinza okutwala akaseera katono. Ekifaananyi kisigala ku ssimu yo.
decisionSupportOnly: Gano magezi gokka. Tegasikira mukugu mu by'obulimi oba omukozi w'ebyobulimi mu kitundu.
modelScoresNotProbabilities: Buno bubonero bwa modeli, si bukakafu obw'obulwadde.
scanSaved: Ekikebereddwa kino kitegekeddwa ku kyuma kyo.
shareCopied: Ebyava mu kukebera bikoppeddwa. Osobola okubiteeka mu bubaka.
speechUnavailable: Browser eno tesobola kusoma magezi mu ddoboozi.
speechFailed: Okusoma mu ddoboozi tekusobodde kutandika ku kyuma kino.
guideIntro: Obubonero obwangu n'ebyo by'oyinza okukola ku birwadde by'ebikoola by'omuwogo. Ekitabo kino kikola nga tewali yintaneeti.
tryAnotherSearch: Gezaako ekigambo ekirala oba gyawo ebigambo by'onoonya.
guideDisclaimer: Amagezi gano gayamba mu kusalawo; si bukakafu bwa bulwadde era tegadda mu kifo kya mukugu mu by'obulimi.
historyIntro: Okukebera kwo okwayita kusigala nga kwa kyama mu browser eno.
emptyHistoryText: Bw'otereka ebyava mu kukebera, bijja kulabika wano. Ebifaananyi biterekebwa nga obufaananyi obutono.
savedLocalOnly: Bitegekeddwa ku kyuma kino kyokka. Bw'osangula data ya browser, ebyafaayo bijja kubula.
helpIntro: Emitendera emitono giyamba okukebera ekifaananyi ky'ekikoola.
chooseLeafFocus: Londa ekikoola kimu eky'omuwogo. Kakasa nti kyeyolefu.
daylightAvoidShadows: Ekitangaala ky'omusana kiyamba. Weewale ebisiikirize n'ebifaananyi ebiddugavu.
compareAndAsk: Geraageranya obubonero n'ekimera kyo. Bw'oba obuusabuusa, buuza omukugu.
canCheckText: Eno etegekerwa okutegeera ebika bitaano eby'ebikoola by'omuwogo: okubabuka kwa bakitiriya, ekirwadde ky'ebbala ery'ekikooko, amabala g'ekibisi, ekirwadde kya mosaiki, n'ekikoola ekirabika ng'ekiramu.
cannotDoText: Tesobola kukakasa buli kirwadde, kumanya birime birala, oba kwekenneenya mirandira. Eyinza okukola ensobi, naddala ku bifaananyi ebitali byeyolefu oba obubonero obutali mu modeli. Obubonero obutono busobola okutegeeza nti tetukakasa, so si nti ekimera kiramu.
photoPrivateText: Modeli ekolera mu browser eno. Ebifaananyi tebitwalibwa ku yintaneeti. Bw'otereka ebyavaamu, akafaananyi akatono ke katerekebwa ku kyuma kino.
helpDisclaimer: PlantPulse eyamba mu kusalawo naye tesikira mukugu mu by'obulimi. Obulwadde bwe bubuna mangu oba amakungula ne gakendeera ennyo, tuukirira omukozi w'ebyobulimi mu kitundu.
aboutIntro: Ebikwata ku browser eno ne modeli ekola ku kyuma.
aboutAccuracy: Modeli eno ekolera ku kyuma kyo nga ekozesa TensorFlow.js. Ebyavaamu magezi, si bukakafu bwa bulwadde. Modeli yafuna obutuufu bwa 70.98% ku bifaananyi bye baakebera; mu nnimiro eyinza okukola mu ngeri endala.
aboutPrivacy: Tewetaaga akawunti okukebera. Ebifaananyi tebitwalibwa ku yintaneeti. Obudde bw'okukebera businziira ku kyuma ne browser yo.
onboardingTakeText: Laga ekikoola kimu eky'omuwogo mu kitangaala ekirungi.
onboardingCheckText: PlantPulse gerageranya ekifaananyi kyo n'ebifaananyi by'ebikoola by'omuwogo.
onboardingAdviceText: Soma amagezi amangu era otereke ebyo bye wakebera ku ssimu yo.
